candidates.title: Metro depot introduces condition-based pantograph inspection
candidates.search_snippet: A metro depot introduced a sensor-assisted method for pantograph inspection between service cycles.
candidates.source_content: Synthetic maintenance bulletin. A metro depot introduced a sensor-assisted condition-based inspection method for pantographs between service cycles. The bulletin explains the inspection sequence, measured indicators, test period, and maintenance decision.

contract_notes: A new maintenance, testing, or construction method can be a technology case when the evidence has factual substance.
